Usage: astryx swizzle [options] [component]

Copy component source for customization

Options:
  --output <dir>   Output directory (default: "./components/astryx")
  --package <pkg>  Scope to a specific owning package. Use @astryxdesign/core to copy an original replaced by an integration component
  --list           List the swizzlable Core components, including any that an integration component replaces
  -f, --overwrite  Replace the component's existing files. Without it, existing files fail the command with ERR_FILE_EXISTS and nothing is written. A helper an earlier swizzle wrote is reused when it is the same and is never replaced by a copy that carries it: a different one stays, and this copy writes its own under a version-suffixed name. Swizzling the component whose folder holds that helper counts it as one of that component's own files. A changed private attribute owner module, or a style module it imports, fails the command without --overwrite and is replaced with it
  -h, --help       display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  unknown or ambiguous component, no source on disk, a path escape, or existing files without --overwrite

Examples:
  # List swizzlable components
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 swizzle --list
  # Eject a component
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 swizzle Button
  # Copy a replaced Core original
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 swizzle SideNav --package @astryxdesign/core

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/swizzle
